## Summary
- Split **dev** (`docker-compose.yml` → :3000) and **prod** (`docker-compose.prod.yml` → :80)
- Add `bun start:prod` / `bun stop:prod` and `scripts/deploy-prod.sh`
- Deploy skips Docker rebuild when build inputs are unchanged (fingerprint), targeting <30s Actions time

## Test plan
- [ ] `bun start` serves http://localhost:3000
- [ ] `bun start:prod` serves http://localhost:80
- [ ] Merge to main → Deploy workflow healthy on http://54.205.169.117/
- [ ] Second deploy (docs-only) skips build and finishes under 30s


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Prod compose on :80 + faster EC2 deploys
